dcterms:description: The DS-I Tobacco signature dataset contains 189 relatively clean and high-quality signatures from 63 authors, with three per author. All the signatures are full signatures, meaning each contains the full name of the author.
dcterms:title: DS-I Tobacco Signature Dataset

dcterms:description: The DS-II UMD signature dataset contains 26661 signatures from 887 authors. It is a more challenging and realistic dataset since the signatures are extracted from the Tobacco litigation corpus, containing memos and letters. It is a mixture of both full signatures and partial signatures.
dcterms:title: DS-II UMD Signature Dataset

dcterms:description: The DS-I partial dataset is derived from the DS-I Tobacco signature dataset by manually selecting partial signatures by clipping out the first names of all full signatures.
dcterms:title: DS-I Partial Signature Dataset

dcterms:description: The DS-II partial dataset contains 495 full signatures for training from 495 authors and 1732 signatures that contain both partial and full signatures for testing.
dcterms:title: DS-II Partial Signature Dataset
